premises.text: Small and medium businesses struggle to understand and make good energy decisions due to overwhelming energy data.
premises.evidence_span: Businesses are surrounded by energy data, but few of them use it.

premises.text: Energy bills contain multiple pieces of information that can help businesses understand their usage and spending.
premises.evidence_span: his energy bill actually contains over 30 unique pieces of information, which can help him understand what he's using and what he's spending.

premises.text: Consultants provide energy reports that can help businesses save money, but these reports often go unused.
premises.evidence_span: the consultant produces an energy report for him, which shows Sean how he can save by doing some simple actions, which he implements. Then the report sits on a shelf.

premises.text: Energy costs are a significant expense for small and medium businesses, leading to missed savings opportunities.
premises.evidence_span: Energy is one of the top costs for small and medium businesses. In fact, every single day, businesses miss out on hundreds of opportunities to save money in this area.

premises.text: Energy Elephant helps businesses build, visualize, and analyze their energy data using their energy bills.
premises.evidence_span: Energy Alpha solves this problem by helping businesses build, visualize, and analyze their energy data.

premises.text: The platform provides insights and comparisons to help businesses optimize their energy usage and costs.
premises.evidence_span: We combine Sean's data with external data sources, to show him how he's performing against the best-in-class.

premises.text: The rollout of smart meters will provide larger data sets for energy analytics.
premises.evidence_span: Energy data analytics is still in its infancy. And with the rollout of smart meters, even larger data sets are going to become available.

premises.text: New legislation will require energy certificates for buildings, which Energy Elephant can help produce.
premises.evidence_span: there's also new legislation coming out that ensures that every building in Europe will need an energy certificate of some sort.

premises.text: Energy Elephant offers a free service for users who upload their energy bills.
premises.evidence_span: Anybody can use the Energy Elephant system for free, if they have an energy bill.

premises.text: Paying customers receive ongoing analysis for a low fee, which helps them save on energy costs.
premises.evidence_span: we charge us a fee of less than £1 per day, per site.

premises.text: The platform has identified significant cost savings for its paying customers.
premises.evidence_span: we've identified cost savings of an average of 15% for our paying customers, helping them reduce their costs by thousands.

value.text: Businesses can make better energy decisions and reduce costs through data analysis.
value.evidence_span: This helps Sean make better investment decisions in the area of energy.

notes: Consultant reports and energy bill details are included as premises. No traction metrics included.
